title: The Psychomagic Art Lab — Ralli Museum Caesarea
summary: Three monthly sessions at Ralli Museum Caesarea exploring the link between making, imagination and healing, inspired by Alejandro Jodorowsky's psychomagic. Led by Uri Sivan, Ari Folman and Mor Kadishzon with senior artists. Each participant develops a new 'psychomagic act', culminating in a group exhibition at the museum in March 2027. Free to participate; places are limited and entry is by selection.

Deadline 20.10.2026 and 'השתתפות ללא תשלום' (participation free of charge) both stated on that page. Sessions: last week of November 2026, December 2026, January 2027. Group exhibition at Ralli Museum, March 2027. Required materials as listed on the application form: CV (PDF, max 1 page), three previous works, a 3-5 minute introduction video (hosted link, not upload), portfolio/website link. title: 10th International Contemporary Teapot Art Biennial (China)
summary: Open to ceramic artists under the theme 'Connecting The World, Through Clay'. A teapot is not required — any free ceramic work may be submitted. Finalists receive five days' full hosting in China including return flights and accommodation, with professional tours including the Yixing teapot tradition. Free to submit; the selected work travels with the artist.

title: TerrArt Magazine — 40th anniversary issue (Catalonia)
summary: For the 40th anniversary of the Catalan Ceramists Association (ACC), the association invites ceramic artists worldwide to take part in the next issue of TerrArt, its twice-yearly contemporary ceramics journal. Ten artists are selected, one of whom appears on the cover; each receives a two-page feature. Theme: ceramic artists offering new perspectives on artistic expression.

title: International Ceramics Exhibition Mino, Japan
summary: Theme: the potential of ceramics. Submitted works are asked to depart from traditional conceptions, show creative imagination and explore the potential held in the material and the language of ceramics. Two categories, art or design, with up to three works per category. Free to submit; shipping at the artist's expense.
